definitions: Put a lid or cover on.
Cover the top or end of something.
Set a limit on (expenditure, an increase, or a claim).
Surpass (a story or an achievement) with one's own equal or greater one.
Complete (a series of events or a story) with a final, often climactic, event or detail.
examples: The council voted to cap local tax increases.
He tried to cap her story with an even wilder one.
The evening was capped by a spectacular fireworks display.
